highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 improves native package hardening and restores missing platform-specific surface and symbol support.
highlights_body: The release adds missing tvOS creation overloads, preserves Android symbols, and strengthens Windows native binaries.

bullets.detail: tvOS consumers regain the SKSurface.Create overloads needed to create compatible rendering surfaces.
Android native symbols are preserved in the package output to improve diagnosis of native crashes.
Windows builds enable Control Flow Guard and buffer-security checks, while Linux and Windows native builds gain Spectre mitigations.

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 restored tvOS surface creation overloads and Android symbol packaging.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 added Windows native binary hardening.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Preview 3 finalized the native mitigation work.

harfbuzz_summary: Includes the HarfBuzz binding work delivered with the preview line.
